source_recipe.rationale: The first gate keeps the art source as a deterministic text recipe so binary transport cannot silently corrupt the PNG.

review_notes: Silhouette, crown/helmet, weapon and red-gold focal accents remain readable across all three value backgrounds.
Feet align to the intended gameplay baseline without visible crop or pivot offset in world captures.
The candidate remains readable under the mobile HUD at the intended gameplay scale.

limitations: This is a silhouette/pivot/readability production candidate, not final character illustration quality.
One normalized pose is still reused across idle/run/jump/attack/hurt, so motion quality and costume continuity across distinct poses are not yet validated.
Attack anticipation, active pose, recovery and exact weapon-reach agreement require real attack frames before animation approval.
next_gate: Produce distinct run and attack test frames on the same character/canvas family, normalize them through ARCONT, then validate drift, combat reach and motion readability before expanding the full animation set.
